rows.title: Pump Organ Song
notes: “I'm going to start with the beautiful song Pump Organ Song”
2022 single from the 'Orpheus Looking Back' EP (Sargent House), not from Marked for Death as the presenter implied.

rows.title: Abba Na
notes: 2018 Apple Media Africa

rows.title: Medusa
notes: “then Medusa off the album Marked for Death”
Track 3 on 'Marked for Death' (Sargent House, 2016), exactly as announced.

rows.title: Renaissance
notes: “and at the top also with a track called Renaissance”
HTRK's name is literally pronounced 'Hate Rock'; 'Renaissance' is an instrumental on their 2022 demos/rarities collection 'Death Is a Dream'.

rows.title: I Just Came to Pray
notes: “I Just Came to Pray by Sarah-Mary Chadwick there from her incredible The Queen Who Stole the Sky album”
Track on 'The Queen Who Stole the Sky' (2019), recorded live on the Melbourne Town Hall grand organ.

rows.title: Slop
notes: 2016 Marathon Artists

rows.title: April
notes: “we had Armlock with a track called April”
Opening track of 'Trust' (2021) by Melbourne emo/indie duo Armlock.

rows.title: Chloe
notes: “Chakra Effendi with a track called Chloe”

rows.title: Flickering
notes: “This is Flickering by Submarine Feet on Sleepless in Sydney”
Debut 2016 single on Tri Angle Records, produced by The Haxan Cloak; 'Submarine Feet' is an ASR mis-hearing of 'serpentwithfeet'.

rows.title: Possessed
notes: “you just heard Circular Keys... I really, really loved that album. It's called Sorry and the track was called Possessed.”
Nine-minute closing track of the Circular Keys album 'Sorry', reviewed by 4ZZZ.

rows.title: Down in a Mirror
notes: “This is Down in the Mirror by Jan Deck On the theme of melancholy this evening on Sleepless in Sydney”
Opening track of 'Chair Beside a Window' (Corwood Industries, 1982); 'Jan Deck' is an ASR mis-hearing of 'Jandek'.

rows.title: Ten Times a Day, Every Day, a Stranger
notes: “The devastating final track of I've Fought Against It But I Can't Any Longer, an album by the band The Body. The song was called Ten Times a Day, Every Day, a Stranger.”
Closing, title-referencing track of 'I Have Fought Against It, But I Can't Any Longer' (Thrill Jockey, 2018), exact match.

rows.title: Forgetting You Is Like Breathing Water
notes: “this next one is a beautiful song or piece of music by Ben Frost called Forgetting You Is Like Breathing Water”
Closing track on 'Theory of Machines' (2007), an 11-minute ambient piece.

rows.title: Stravaig
notes: “the next song I think has a similar feeling to it it's by Nick Ashwood off the compilation... this is a track called Stravague”
Sydney/Tasmanian guitarist's track on the Absorb label compilation 'The World I Want Would Be Celestial, Wet' (2022); 'Stravague' is a mis-hearing of 'Stravaig'.

rows.title: Ya Alla
notes: 2007 Lord Sound

rows.title: I Don't Hate You
notes: “E. Fishpool with a track called I Don't Hate You off the Absorb compilation”
Exact-title track by E Fishpool (Emily Fishpool) on the same Absorb compilation 'The World I Want Would Be Celestial, Wet' (2022).

rows.title: Clairvoyant
notes: “This is a track called Clairvoyant”
Opening, 18-minute track on 'Vanish' (Editions Mego, 2020), credited as Julia Reidy (now Jules Reidy).

rows.title: Rainmaker (Extended Club Mix)
notes: 2012 Ellina Music
